wiki.title: Frank Iler
wiki.extract: Francis Robertson "Frank" Iler Jr. (born. January 10, 1942) is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives. Iler has represented the 17th district (including constituents in Brunswick County) since 2009. A retired businessman who lives in Oak Island, North Carolina, Iler was appointed when Bonner Stiller resigned in 2009.
